issue_request: FHIR-12654 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-I change request asking that DocumentManifest, DocumentReference, and Media be listed as Event-pattern resources on the workflow page.
initial_application: The request was applied by svn revision 11098, mirrored as git commit 3a52430d146e848ec73bc952611d1a14b203e4b5, which added all three resources to source/workflow.html.
additional_context: Current source/workflow.html still lists DocumentReference. Later R5 work changed the resource set: FHIR-23567 merged Media into DocumentReference and removed Media from workflow.html/fhir.ini, while FHIR-33021 and FHIR-39006 record DocumentManifest retirement/List follow-on work and commit ea941737076615e7e2772299c80c63e1490f2e93 removed DocumentManifest from workflow.html and active resources.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding DocumentManifest or Media would be stale for the current build because DocumentManifest is removed and Media is no longer an active resource; DocumentReference already satisfies the still-current part of the seed request.
